A '''TIE pilot''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fought in defense of the Imperial-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of Gall|attack]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Flying a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], the zealous [[TIE pilot|pilot]] went head-to-head with [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] but was destroyed in the encounter.
